workspace.ownership: One process holds the existing workspace .workspace.lock; threads share its native mutex. Do not open a second mutating CLI while the service owns the workspace.
workspace.source: Unchanged 33-file Forms product plus nine complete authoring/receiving/Installation files; workspace.json binds all 42 exact source bodies.
workspace.database: SQLite DELETE journal with synchronous FULL; original requests and full draft history remain in workspace.sqlite.

dispatch.request: Every mutation requires a stable request_id matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}. The exact same method/parameters recover or return that original request. A different body with that ID is rejected. Preserve the ID and original body before HTTP dispatch. A returned failure is terminal; a corrected action has a new explicit request. Process loss leaves the original frozen request RUNNING for its identical recovery.

workspace.describe.value: Complete workspace identity/source files, native revision, capture/draft/run/request counts and explicit raw limit.

capture.show.value: Original capture descriptor after source verification.

capture.assets.value: Complete original asset records, total/offset/limit; paging never limits native calculation.

capture.worksheet.value: Whole original mapping-worksheet.json including complete metadata and explicit original attachment links.

capture.csv.value: capture_id,asset_id,source,encoding,headers,header_unique,total,offset,limit,rows:[{record:one-based data ordinal,values:complete literal array,width_valid:boolean}],meaning. Strict complete CSV scan and indexed raw paging; no inferred types or keys. Explicit one-character delimiter/quotechar agree with the original engine and form part of the immutable CSV cache identity.

draft.list.value: Paged metadata for current named drafts; draft.show returns complete raw text.

draft.show.value: Complete selected current or historical draft, including raw text, source review, capture and original request.

draft.history.value: All named draft revisions via paging, newest first. Original revision bodies remain downloadable through draft.show.

draft.validate.value: valid,errors,stage,draft_id,draft_revision and intake_sha256 when structurally valid. STRUCTURE_VALID means original native manifest/key/field/asset validation; native source quality and attachment findings require run.create.

run.show.value: Verified complete run descriptor including project, received, project_identity, source_run_identity, complete project archive, source selection, six class states and output counts.

request.show.value: Complete original method, parameters, frozen input, status/result/error and timestamps. Uses the single owner mutex.

request.status.value: Original method/status/timestamps/error and actual immutable phase records; a separate read-only SQLite connection permits polling during the native operation. Returns no invented progress percentage.

capture.import.effect: Receive a whole original forms_capture.pack ZIP from the workspace/incoming directory through original forms_capture.receive and verify. Same exact archive SHA returns the retained capture. No provider call occurs.

params.name: complete name
params.rebind_reference: required nonempty decision when switching captures
params.base_draft_revision: Required exact historical native revision whenever base_draft_id is selected

draft.create.effect: Start the original complete mapping-required intake. A same-capture fork retains exact unfinished raw text. An explicitly reviewed new-capture rebind retains old/new complete asset differences, prior draft ID/revision and the operator reference; it replaces original inventory and bound CSV path/hash identities. All existing explicit mappings and parent decisions remain for actual native checking. The exact selected historical base revision is frozen before admission; a concurrently saved later revision is never silently substituted. Full before/after capture metadata and inventory differences remain in source_review.

draft.save.effect: Atomic compare-and-save of complete raw draft and original revision history. Invalid or unfinished text can be saved exactly. A later native revision is never silently replaced. Explicit limit128MiB encoded UTF-8.

run.create.effect: Freeze the exact original complete draft and capture, run the unchanged native engine into a new immutable project, verify, pack, independently receive and verify the complete returned project. Phase records reflect returned stages. Recover a process interruption with the same original request ID and parameters.

large_files.upload: The local server streams a full selected capture ZIP to an exclusive temporary input, fsyncs and finalizes its exact file in workspace/incoming before capture.import. It validates declared limits and actual byte count/digest. Keep upload temporary files outside incoming until complete; incomplete uploads cannot become original selected input. Never buffer a complete ZIP in JSON or select an arbitrary remote-supplied host path.
large_files.downloads: Stream original files, project ZIPs and full workspace ZIPs. Use server-selected IDs and complete source checks, never path traversal or browser-memory reconstruction.
large_files.privacy: Receipts, native paths and tokens remain in original private control directories. Bind to127.0.0.1 with generated private capability and Host/Origin/Fetch-Site checks. Public source carries no customer inputs.

handover.contents: Complete consistent SQLite backup, workspace metadata, all original capture archives/received captures, native run inputs/projects/project ZIPs/independently received projects, full original request and draft histories, operation phase records, and42 source files. Ephemeral cache and process lock are reconstructed. Pending original requests must be recovered before export.
handover.reopen: Run the actually received software/forms_workspace.py or its server against the independently received workspace. Continue original workspace identity/draft history and request IDs; no second business case.
handover.local_import: forms_workspace.py import-capture --workspace ORIGINAL --archive COMPLETE_ZIP --request-id STABLE_ID streams and retains a selected local capture using the same native owner; close an active HTTP owner first.

installation.commercial: Actual FormAssembly work remains unpriced. Native Installation can retain its ordinary unbound commercial draft. A priced Workshare is an explicit existing native source only.
installation.binding: Bind actual workspace ID/revision, selected run/draft/capture IDs, project identity, exact project ZIP and full workspace archive to the original operating case. Selection metadata is a binding, not a substitute for complete large source bodies.

receiving.requirement: Operate complete mapping-required capture to authoring, unfinished draft/revisions/conflict, explicit following source review, native complete editions, complete export and cold reopened history. Open/use the exact outgoing UI and attachments; inspect actual desktop/narrow pixels and every PDF page.
